## Design

### 2026-10-10 – I designed the first part of the wind tunnel, which is the inlet. The inlet is an opening that draws drived air into the circuit. It isolates the tunnel from outside disturbances, and it also transfor

**2h**

I designed the first part of the wind tunnel, which is the inlet. The inlet is an opening that draws drived air into the circuit. It isolates the tunnel from outside disturbances, and it also transforms the air into a smooth, straight-line stream. I attached a real-world example of an inlet.

![Screenshot 2026-10-10 at 13.31.09](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/gKTwWBgpcbO5BUqOyUTSgj0GrR9ZXm77/778fa14d03aec68ed035823e7c5755976e8c8743ab304750dd98db2dfe53c04d.png)

### 2026-10-10 – I designed the next part of the wind tunnel, which is the nozzle. The nozzle is a contoured section that is placed just before the test section, and it is used to accelerate the airflow and create a s

**2h**

I designed the next part of the wind tunnel, which is the nozzle. The nozzle is a contoured section that is placed just before the test section, and it is used to accelerate the airflow and create a smooth stream. I attached a picture that I used as inspiration for my design of the nozzle.

![90c128322188c2fc9aa5b2243dafef28a8ca4dfe897f8e3098faf52f51217774](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/gKTwWBgpcbO5BUqOyUTSgj0GrR9ZXm77/d39d1ae3c9c4ed34088a97ccf7f674978f8b14e84f98c817e8444d7b377607af.webp)

![1525338834970](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/gKTwWBgpcbO5BUqOyUTSgj0GrR9ZXm77/9f647a7c6d3991528af0c02a6a9d0a20c27e79de8e9700abd2fd2629160845c8.png)

### 2026-10-10 – The next section was the test section. This is the central chamber of the wind tunnel. The test section is where the actual aerodynamic experiment occurs. It is also where the data on the model is col

**6h**

The next section was the test section. This is the central chamber of the wind tunnel. The test section is where the actual aerodynamic experiment occurs. It is also where the data on the model is collected.

![edcf37cb4e78d80b11044fd5eeccad5120aac3078567f1c864f7dc81cad2a51e](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/gKTwWBgpcbO5BUqOyUTSgj0GrR9ZXm77/13528e25cfcd070dbafde8e2f21688bf6d6d673bc95fd8bf77dc914000ec8d3b.webp)

![Screenshot 2026-10-10 at 13.43.47](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/gKTwWBgpcbO5BUqOyUTSgj0GrR9ZXm77/ad33f5f84c2e0b2c2d3fd52513841497ae907e0da1fedf72e05089036c3d7c1e.png)

The next part is the comb. The comb is a metal strip with a series of tiny tubes spaced close together. It is used to measure air speed and pressure at multiple points at the same time across a cross-section of the airflow.

![519bfb1a844af91e63a7234ee89ac1d3b80fac9f4a8d47a5443ddb00f923e642](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/gKTwWBgpcbO5BUqOyUTSgj0GrR9ZXm77/d72e25c0784e5ca54ec1366cbf41fbe45bbd0208f06bfa1ec57ffaebd8dc4ba2.webp)

![Screenshot 2026-10-10 at 13.45.34](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/gKTwWBgpcbO5BUqOyUTSgj0GrR9ZXm77/51b3482b115df3a87b9ff0b656b9c850dbfd69721c05c7b0f1c52a501770e51f.png)

The next part is the diffuser. The diffuser on a wind tunnel converts kinetic energy into static pressure by slowing down fast-moving air. It is placed right before the fan so that electrical energy is saved as much as possible.

![8005155f6e00ae6ed72f3eef831defe57da020ec94acce8cfbbc41021f746b99](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/gKTwWBgpcbO5BUqOyUTSgj0GrR9ZXm77/8005155f6e00ae6ed72f3eef831defe57da020ec94acce8cfbbc41021f746b99.jpg)

![Screenshot 2026-10-10 at 13.47.31](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/gKTwWBgpcbO5BUqOyUTSgj0GrR9ZXm77/05ef44c6ad3ed29f95c9a5051c5c3fe3143c2a90b43f121ef5605d44fca78428.png)

### 2026-10-10 – The final part is the exit, which is a sub-part of the diffuser. The exit is where the fan is located. It is also used to slow down the airflow, like the diffuser. The exit has all the same functions

**2h**

The final part is the exit, which is a sub-part of the diffuser. The exit is where the fan is located. It is also used to slow down the airflow, like the diffuser. The exit has all the same functions as the diffuser.

![f2a5de780fbd7804229417973546e0ba19ad26be80e9c624bc151a5b13b5bd11](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/gKTwWBgpcbO5BUqOyUTSgj0GrR9ZXm77/fd068d73a221aa97407b92dca5786414389133a5864cf4b2b7aa4c971de3c8fb.webp)
